insights.ja: みずほが貯蓄預金金利を16年半ぶり復活、メガバンク間の預金争奪が本格化
insights.en: Mizuho revives tiered savings deposit rates after 16.5 years; megabank deposit competition intensifies

insights.ja: 地方預金の首都圏集中が加速、相続とNISAシフトで地銀資金基盤がさらに縮小
insights.en: Regional deposit concentration in greater Tokyo accelerates via inheritance and NISA shift, further eroding local bank funding bases

insights.ja: 若年層（18-24歳）の金融資産ジニが0.718と最高水準、格差の固定化リスク
insights.en: Youth (18-24) financial-asset Gini hits 0.718, highest among ages; risk of locked-in inequality

insights.ja: 貧困は監視対象ではなく、尊厳ある再分配とUBI実験の倫理的起点
insights.en: Poverty is not a surveillance target; it is the ethical starting point for dignified redistribution and UBI experiments

insights.ja: メガの金利競争を地方還流の機会に変え、預金格差を学習で緩和
insights.en: Turning megabank rate competition into an opportunity for regional capital recirculation and learning to ease deposit gaps

news.title: Mizuho revives savings deposit rates; regional banks face deepening deposit outflow
news.titleJa: みずほ貯蓄預金金利復活、地銀は預金流出圧力がさらに強まる
news.summary: Mizuho becomes first megabank to reinstate balance-linked savings rates (up to 0.90%). Regional banks confront intensifying competition, Tokyo deposit concentration (50.7%), and inheritance-driven outflows.
news.summaryJa: みずほがメガ初の残高連動貯蓄預金金利を復活（最大0.90%）。地銀は競争激化・首都圏預金集中（50.7%）・相続による流出圧力に直面。

news.title: Japan eyes earlier cash support for low-income households by spring 2029
news.titleJa: 低所得世帯向け現金給付、2029年春への前倒しを検討
news.summary: Government considers advancing income-linked cash payments to spring 2029 to bridge the end of temporary consumption-tax cuts, moving closer to broader basic-income-style support.
news.summaryJa: 政府は一時的消費税減税終了後の空白を埋めるため、所得連動型現金給付を2029年春に前倒し検討。より広範な基本所得型支援に近づく動き。
